summary: @servicetitan/cp-mfe-dev preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is written in obfuscator.io-style hex-identifier form (identifiers such as `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, dictionary-indirection wrappers) and downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/...` into a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled `math_init.js` at install time. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB `@bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle using a rotating string-array dispatcher (`WV8StW` / `MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())`), a >2000-entry mixed integer/string decode table, and hex-renamed identifiers — its contents are opaque and are not referenced by the package's advertised developer-tooling surface. The Bun download runs even when a system `bun` is present, matching the alternate-runtime dropper pattern where an unrelated language runtime is fetched at install time so a bundled, obfuscated payload can execute outside the Node-based analysis surface. Additional network-command patterns are present in `dist/settings-client.js` and `dist/user-client.js` (ping/POST/GET). The scope `@servicetitan/*` suggests this may be a typosquat or scope hijack of ServiceTitan's namespace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
